items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We talked together the other day... She was thanking me for, you know, giving her that respect.

ctx.x: Yeah, Quincy. Melba was also in Dizzy’s bandwidth me. There was one band that I was, Chuck Israel Orchestra with a bunch of people. Janice Robinson was fresh out of Eastman. She was a good little girl and I was her hero. Actually, both of us being black, the pitted us together with both of us in a room on the road. I actually sat in the lobby so she could have the room and be a little lady, you know? We talked together the other day and they laughed. “Is that what you were doing? Is that why you were gone?” “Yep,…
So, they actually, rather than having you room with another male, they put you with a woman.
